title: CN: John's eight plain-language working-day checks
public_pr_body:
Adds tests/JOHN-PQ-RUN-SHEET.md with the requested first eight PQ checks: clicks, expected results, Pass/Fail/Not run boxes, private evidence notes and John's signature. Uses a private restored copy of real JNR records, compared with SliQ, plus clearly separated trial actions and blocked external delivery. John does not sign for Rhys.

Source discrepancy kept visible: the current PQ.md/VSR has nine planned checks. This sheet covers PQ-001–008 and explicitly retains PQ-009 as the separate cutover condition; no official count or result is changed. Some adversarial/provider checks require Code's actual report before John may tick Pass.

Checks: eight source headings and eight result boxes verified, PQ-009 boundary and real-data copy scope checked against current PQ/manual source. Documentation only; no runtime execution, data access, SQL, main merge or Ready label. Source head d7d6ff9dbd915becdc096d1eb365e4a73b4ae21d. Sibling CO/CP guides are clearly marked as available when included in the reviewed pack.

- [x] Plain click/check sheet, eight result boxes and source review
- [ ] John runs it with Code; Rhys reviews the genuine results

CR follow-through: exact reviewed #314 wording is now retained here (CN blocks external AI on restored real data and limits export checks to Xero; CU requires actual admin MFA challenge and scopes AI-off evidence). Current head bfaa31b84ebb04cec74c386787806320c3dee44e. These documentation corrections were made after CV's frozen test snapshot; no new runtime pass is claimed.
